# Contributing

If you wish to contribute to the sculife-app codebase or documentation, feel free to fork the repository and submit a pull request. We use **Prettier** to enforce a consistent coding style, so having that set up in your editor of choice is a great boon to your development process.

## Setup

To get ready to work on the codebase, please do the following:

1. Fork & clone the repository, and make sure you're on the **main** branch
2. Run `bun install` ([install bun](https://bun.sh/docs/installation))
3. Run `bun start` to start expo server
4. Code your heart out!
5. [Submit a pull request](https://github.com/sculife/sculife-app/compare) (Make sure you follow the [conventional commit format](./COMMIT_CONVENTION.md))

#### Docs Referring

Refer to the documentation of discord.js [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/discordjs/discord.js/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md)
